# Rotate 1D Array — left

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

Positive offset moves the last elements to the front. Negative offset rotates left. Complete cycles preserve values and order.

## What this example demonstrates

Positive offset moves the last elements to the front. Negative offset rotates left. Complete cycles preserve values and order.
